units.source_text: 语言把我从深陷的无力中弹了出来。

en.t: Language sprang me out of the helplessness into which I had sunk so deeply.

units.source_text: 顷刻间我浑身充满了力量。

en.t: In an instant, my whole body was filled with strength.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，心灵的一部分却执拗地告诉我，

en.t: Even so, one part of my heart stubbornly told me

units.source_text: 今后我应该做的事是徒然的，我的力量变得不惧怕白费了。

en.t: that what I ought to do from now on would be futile, and my strength had become unafraid of being wasted.

units.source_text: 因为是徒然，才是我应该做的。

en.t: Because it was futile, it was precisely what I ought to do.
